timing.roots: first16 fresh parent roots, never used in PGO training
timing.order: AB/BA alternating engine order; reverse root order on odd replicate; one warm depth8 search per engine/mode; one thread and64MiB, no concurrent compilation/matches.
timing.ratio: candidate/control sum of wall elapsed per16-root batch; bootstrap batch medians

limits: Held-out roots; desktop wall time includes protocol/reset, without affinity/isolation. Ratios do not establish Elo or reference superiority.
